description:
Trigger a bulk export through the Data Management package REST API and return
the download URL when complete. NOTE: the DMF EXPORT project (definitionGroupId)
must already exist in FO with its entities + mapping configured -- create it with
dmf_create_data_project if needed. For ad-hoc exports without a project, use
odata_export_entity instead.

definitionGroupId.description: Existing DMF export project (definitionGroupId) in FO.

legalEntity.description: Legal entity / company id to export from, e.g. 'USMF'.

packageName.description: Optional package name. Default derived from the project id.

pollTimeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to poll for completion. Default 300.

reExecute.description: Re-execute the project (true) or reuse last staging (false). Default true.

name: dmf_export_package
